title: senderUserId validated against WhoIs before any DB write
description: kith-peer/src/lib.rs:139: the WhoIs-verified identity is compared against senderUserId at step 3 before the store Mutex is acquired. There is no code path that writes to the database before this check. A contributor might suggest moving this check later for 'efficiency' (avoid the WhoIs call if parsing fails first), but moving it after any DB access creates a TOCTOU window where attacker-controlled content is stored before identity is verified.
